title: Logo findings read back from jsonb with reordered keys count as the same findings, so a Retry that finds nothing new keeps the logo research
steps: S1: compare logo findings with a candidate against the same findings whose object keys come back in another order (as jsonb returns them) and a different clock.
S2: compare them against findings with another status.
evidence: e2e dev 24/10/2026: a Retry that changed nothing still wrote new logo research because JSON.stringify compared a fresh object with one read back from jsonb
fence: sameLogoFindings compares a key-sorted canonical form

tests: the same logo findings read back from jsonb with keys reordered are the same findings
